prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Wide shot. A giant long rectangular wooden crate of rough planks smeared pitch-black, with a flat plank roof and flat square ends, as tall at both ends as in the middle, sits level in brown floodwater swirling around it, the roof empty and flat, people in silhouette on the hillside in the foreground watching it. Grey day, rain and churning water. Mighty and terrible. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
